name: Gabor Phase Congruency
description: Analyzes Gabor filter phase responses for multi-scale AI artifact detection in textured regions.
algorithm: Gabor Phase Congruency分析アルゴリズム

Directly at the spliced fold between a synthesized torso and the victim's authentic neckline... the system detects a devastating Phase shift exceeding 180 degrees. The sirens wail! Irrefutable proof of a non-native, biologically impossible splice.
